invariants.rule: todo-orchestrator SQLite is the sole work-state authority; canonical repository source is the sole code authority. Generated ledgers, context packets, local-worker reports, benchmark summaries, and profiler summaries are evidence only.

Preserve existing todo-orchestrator, cuda, and cpp-context-compiler public commands, JSON envelopes, defaults, state readability, and substantive guidance. New behavior is additive and versioned; fake local-worker execution remains available as a deterministic test fixture.
invariants.enforcement: compatibility fixtures and final full suites

invariants.rule: Optimize Codex-visible tokens, source reads, retries, and tool calls per accepted task. Prefer deterministic helpers, bounded packets, compact results, focused tests, and one manual asset gate.
Preserve unrelated user changes. Never reset, clean, overwrite, stage, commit, or attribute paths outside the active task scope without audit.
invariants.enforcement: todo ownership, worktrees, and Git audit

invariants.rule: A generated and externally verified patch is only ready_for_acceptance. It is not accepted, succeeded, or parent-complete until guarded application and current-source acceptance gates succeed.
Patch, source identity, context packet reference, verification, telemetry, reviewer evidence, and compact result are durable git-common-dir artifacts before a child becomes ready_for_acceptance.
No contaminated CUDA measurement may update a baseline, create a performance fact, or trigger profiler escalation. Post-run quiescence is validated before classification and persistence.

Production model payloads are installed once into a verified persistent SSD cache and are never copied from block storage or fully rehashed on each skill call. GPU-hot residency is optional, preemptible, and lower priority than clean CUDA foreground work.

Local workers consume todo-authorized bounded work, use isolated source state, have a strict tool allowlist, no network, no recursive agents, no architecture authority, and may return NEEDS_CODEX successfully.

GPU topology and inference islands are discovered at runtime and may change after cable reconfiguration. Physical GPU ownership is host-global. Local inference is absent during uncontaminated CUDA timing and profiling.
Treat V100 as compute capability 7.0/sm_70 and use an explicit CUDA 12.x build toolchain for Volta code. The R580 driver-reported CUDA maximum is not the GPU compute capability.

Do not download models, install large external stacks, copy a large model to SSD, or alter GPU cabling without the user. Finish software-only work first, then halt once with one exact model-cache request if the active model is not already ready.

Run the smallest decisive test while implementing. Run full skill suites only at baseline, software-ready, real-worker-ready, and final release checkpoints. Do not sweep all models, contexts, harnesses, or topologies.
